import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*t**2 + p[4]*np.exp(-t)
    amp = p[5] + p[6]*t
    K = np.exp(p[7] + p[8]*t)
    n = p[9]
    An = np.abs(A)**n
    return base + amp*An/(K**n + An)
